reviews_1s:
Very cute, but reading the other reviews I'd be scared to make tea and put hot water in them so they're kind of useless. I tried using these for coffee and put syrup in the cup first(for cooling purposes) and took a risk to brew a cup of coffee in it, I had a towel on stand by in case the glass cracked lol. The glass did not crack thankfully, but I brew 10oz, and add in 2 pumps of syrup and a little cream, and you can't put the lid on so they're not big enough to use with the lid. Also theres that fear in the back of your mind that this will be the time the non-tempered glass cracks. They're so cute though so I tried stacking them on my coffee bar with the lid on just for looks (again pointless) but the lids make it slippery and dangerous, they don't stack securely with the lids on. They do stack nicely with the lids off however but I wanted them specifically to brew tea with the lid on. You could use them at a cold water station but that's about it. I'm not returning because my daughter bought them for my bday, but if I had purchased them myself I'd have returned them. The lids seem not sealed nicely too, the bamboo I mean. So I feel like they'd mold over time, and the dishwasher is out of the question which is a negative.I absolutely hate leaving bad reviews. I know it can hurt. But I had to complain about this purchase. These cups break when we put our food in them if the item is hot. They advertised to be able to put hot things in like coffee, etc. Even the title says "Irish COFFEE glasses....vintage COFFEE mugs". I had my special needs daughter next to me while I poured coffee in one of the mugs. Ten seconds later...boom! It exploded all over the place - hot coffee everywhere. I am not trying to hurt the company but a coffee mug should be able to withstand heat from coffee or soup, etc., without exploding. I'm really sorry....Initially, I was excited about these cups because of their cute design and apparent durability. However, after just a month of use, I was disappointed to discover mold growing in one of the cups. To my dismay, this problem spread to two more cups, and even the lids were affected.

Seeing mold in glassware was a first for me, and despite attempting various cleaning methods, the mold persisted. Ultimately, I had to dispose of everything due to hygiene concerns.

Given this experience, I cannot recommend these cups to others. While they may look nice initially, their tendency to develop mold quickly is a significant drawback.

Pros:
- Cute design
- Initially appeared durable

Cons:
- Prone to mold growth in a short period
- Mold also affected the lids

Unfortunately, I won't be repurchasing these cups and suggest others look for alternatives to avoid similar issues.These are beautiful, but each of the wooden tops are off-centered. Meaning the wooden top protrudes farther out on one side of the cup versus the other, every single one. Quality control issue for sure. Also some of the tops aren’t as secure as others. Meaning the seal isn’t consistent. These did come securely packaged; however, I still wouldn’t recommend to others or give as a gift due to the above reasons.The bamboo lids I received have the cut out hole for the spoon, but I would’ve preferred a solid lid, no cut out. It would be nice if they would give you the option because it seems like many reviewer‘s preferred the opposite of what they received. The dealbreaker for me is that the bamboo lids are unfinished, so they are rough to the touch and could possibly splinter.

The mugs have an attractive pattern, but the low depth is really not practical for coffee; it’s better for a cereal or dessert dish. As others have mentioned, the mugs seem to have a coating on them that has a vinegar smell.

It was nicely packaged, but the box looked like it had something spilled on it. Another reviewer mentioned something similar, leading me to wonder if I got that person’s return.I need to update my review because it’s worse than originally input. The lids seal does not close and creates mold. I have a lid that has molded. This is by far the crappiest order. purchased what I thought was the premium of this variety. The tops sit on the cups crooked and not quite a seal. I should’ve opted for the cheapest. As with that I would’ve expected mediocrity.Product not as described. The lids are not airtight and they do not fit the glass containers, they rattle around as seen in the attached video. Returning as I wanted to use them to meal prep and they don’t seal, defeating the purpose of being able to pack a salad/lunch in them. I looked at some other reviews, and it seems that some people get the proper lids and others don’t, so I guess you roll the dice. Would’ve loved to contact customer support to see if this can be fixed, but was unable to get in contact.Not sure why this has so many great reviews. I took them out of the box and immediately noticed the lids both have tons of splinters already coming out (as pictured) and will definitely get into any food you put in the cups. In addition, the glasses have very visible seams that you can see and feel running down their sides which show how poorly made they are.The set appeared sturdy and very pretty. However, a disappointment. I poured hot water for my tea bag and it cracked right down the middle.I just opened the box as I got these for Christmas and two of the bamboo lids from the set of four are completely cracked.
